blocks.text:
To: Steven Lowe
Cc: Daniel Leach

Thanks for turning the segment file around over the weekend. Daniel Leach has loaded it, and the customer-level detail is there for the largest segment, though the second still comes through at the segment total only. We can start on the first and come back to the second, so this does not hold us up; I have flagged in our notes which segment is running on totals, so nothing downstream mistakes it for account-level detail.

The open item now is scheduling. The segment leads have given us three of the four interview slots. The one outstanding is the head of the industrial line, who I gather is traveling until the following week. If someone on your side can help us land thirty minutes with him, that closes the set: Brenda Rodriguez will run the interview and Daniel Leach will take the notes, and the current-position read for {{fact:f:E-2009-002.client}} firms up once we have heard from all four.
That is the only thing I need from you right now. I will keep this thread current as the interviews land and the sizing fills in.
